src_py: wǒ sòng péng you dào huǒ chē zhàn le
zh: 我把朋友送到火车站了。
py: wǒ bǎ péng you sòng dào huǒ chē zhàn le
en: I took my friend to the railway station.
why: 把 brings the object before the verb, and 到火车站 stays attached to 送 as the place where the friend ends up.

s: 我们应该往老运动员学习。
s_py: wǒ men yīng gāi wǎng lǎo yùn dòng yuán xué xí
zh: 我们应该向老运动员学习。
py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng lǎo yùn dòng yuán xué xí
en: We should learn from the veteran athletes.
why: Learning from a person uses 向. 往 needs a place or direction and real movement, so 往 + person + 学习 is wrong.

s: 我家不离地铁站远。
s_py: wǒ jiā bù lí dì tiě zhàn yuǎn
zh: 我家离地铁站不远。
py: wǒ jiā lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
en: My home is not far from the subway station.
why: 远 is an adjective predicate, so 不 sits directly on it, after 离地铁站. 不离…远 is not a Chinese pattern.

q: 这家书店___我家只有三百米，很方便。
py: zhè jiā shū diàn lí wǒ jiā zhǐ yǒu sān bǎi mǐ hěn fāng biàn
en: This bookshop is only three hundred metres from my home, which is very convenient.
why: 离…只有 + distance states the gap between two places. 从, 往 and 朝 describe movement and cannot be followed by 只有三百米 this way.
zh: 这家书店离我家只有三百米，很方便。

q: 小王常常___朋友一起踢足球。
py: xiǎo wáng cháng cháng gēn péng you yī qǐ tī zú qiú
en: Xiao Wang often plays football with his friends.
why: A partner in a shared activity (一起) is marked by 跟 or 和 before the verb. 在 marks a place, 往 a direction and 为 a beneficiary, so none of them fits 朋友一起.
zh: 小王常常跟朋友一起踢足球。

q: 他练了十年才拿到冠军，我们都___他感到骄傲。
py: tā liàn le shí nián cái ná dào guàn jūn wǒ men dōu wèi tā gǎn dào jiāo ào
en: He trained for ten years before winning the title, and we are all proud of him.
why: Pride felt on someone's account takes 为: 为他感到骄傲. 给 and 跟 mark a recipient and a partner, and 往 a direction.
zh: 他练了十年才拿到冠军，我们都为他感到骄傲。
从我家到体育馆要二十分钟。
py: cóng wǒ jiā dào tǐ yù guǎn yào èr shí fēn zhōng
en: It takes twenty minutes from my home to the gym.
why: A route with a start and an end is 从…到, start first, and 要 plus the duration comes last. 离 could not take 到 here.

q: 他输了比赛，大家都___他难过。
py: tā shū le bǐ sài dà jiā dōu wèi tā nán guò
en: He lost the match and everyone feels sad for him.
why: A feeling felt on someone's behalf takes 为. 往 and 在 mark a direction and a place, and 对他难过 does not say that the sadness is for his sake.
zh: 他输了比赛，大家都为他难过。

src_py: wǒ duì yīn yuè gǎn xìng qù
task: Add 也 to say you are interested too.
zh: 我对音乐也感兴趣。
py: wǒ duì yīn yuè yě gǎn xìng qù
en: I am interested in music too.
why: 也 goes before the predicate 感兴趣, either right before the 对 phrase or just after it, but never after 感兴趣.

zh: 请替我向他问好。
py: qǐng tì wǒ xiàng tā wèn hǎo
en: Please say hello to him for me.
why: 替我 (on my behalf) comes first, then 向他 (the person greeted), then 问好. Both coverb phrases stand before the verb.

q: 我们___下午两点开始练习，一直练到五点。
py: wǒ men cóng xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi shǐ liàn xí yī zhí liàn dào wǔ diǎn
en: We start practising at two in the afternoon and keep going until five.
why: A period that starts at a time takes 从 for its start, matching 到 for its end. 离 measures a gap rather than marking a start, and 往 and 跟 do not take times.
zh: 我们从下午两点开始练习，一直练到五点。

s: 离比赛开始还有十分钟。
s_py: lí bǐ sài kāi shǐ hái yǒu shí fēn zhōng
zh: 离比赛开始还有十分钟。
py: lí bǐ sài kāi shǐ hái yǒu shí fēn zhōng
en: There are still ten minutes until the match starts.
why: 离 with 还有 gives the time left before an event. It has no subject, but it is a standard pattern; 从 would be wrong here.

q: 周末我要___朋友见面。
py: zhōu mò wǒ yào gēn péng you jiàn miàn
en: I'm meeting a friend at the weekend.
why: 见面 is mutual, so the other person is a partner marked by 跟 or 和. 给 would make the friend a recipient and 对 an attitude target.
zh: 周末我要跟朋友见面。

q: 你放心去跑步吧，孩子我___你看着。
py: nǐ fàng xīn qù pǎo bù ba hái zi wǒ tì nǐ kān zhe
en: Go for your run without worry; I'll watch the child for you.
why: 替 means doing the task in your place so that you don't have to. 对 and 往 do not express standing in for someone, and 离 measures distance.
zh: 你放心去跑步吧，孩子我替你看着。

s: 我们骑公共汽车去体育馆。
s_py: wǒ men qí gōng gòng qì chē qù tǐ yù guǎn
zh: 我们坐公共汽车去体育馆。
py: wǒ men zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù tǐ yù guǎn
en: We take the bus to the gym.
why: A bus is ridden as a passenger with 坐. 骑 is only for bikes, horses and the like.

s: 我家从公园很远。
s_py: wǒ jiā cóng gōng yuán hěn yuǎn
zh: 我家离公园很远。
py: wǒ jiā lí gōng yuán hěn yuǎn
en: My home is far from the park.
why: Distance between two fixed places is 离. 从 marks where movement or time starts and cannot be followed by 很远.

src_py: wǒ bǎ piào jiāo gěi lǎo shī le
zh: 我没把票交给老师。
py: wǒ méi bǎ piào jiāo gěi lǎo shī
en: I didn't hand the ticket in to the teacher.
why: 没 goes before 把, and 了 is dropped. 交给 stays together after the verb.

s: 我们昨天没在公园遇到他。
s_py: wǒ men zuó tiān méi zài gōng yuán yù dào tā
zh: 我们昨天没在公园遇到他。
py: wǒ men zuó tiān méi zài gōng yuán yù dào tā
en: We didn't run into him in the park yesterday.
why: 没 goes before the coverb phrase 在公园, which is the standard slot for a negated action. The sentence is correct as it stands.

zh: 到了路口往左拐。
py: dào le lù kǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi
en: Turn left when you get to the junction.
why: 往 + direction comes before the movement verb 拐. The direction cannot follow it, as English 'turn left' does.

s: 这条路从火车站一直通到体育馆。
s_py: zhè tiáo lù cóng huǒ chē zhàn yī zhí tōng dào tǐ yù guǎn
zh: 这条路从火车站一直通到体育馆。
py: zhè tiáo lù cóng huǒ chē zhàn yī zhí tōng dào tǐ yù guǎn
en: This road runs all the way from the railway station to the gym.
why: A road has a start and an end, so 从…到 is right even though nothing physically moves. 离 would be wrong here.

src_py: tā men zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
task: Say they do it every weekend.
zh: 他们每个周末在体育馆打篮球。
py: tā men měi gè zhōu mò zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
en: They play basketball at the gym every weekend.
why: The time phrase comes before the place phrase, which comes before the verb.

src_py: xué xiào lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn
zh: 学校离我家不近。
py: xué xiào lí wǒ jiā bù jìn
en: The school is not close to my home.
why: 不 replaces 很 and sits directly on the adjective 近, after the 离 phrase.

q: 地铁站___这儿有两百米。
py: dì tiě zhàn lí zhè r yǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ
en: The subway station is two hundred metres from here.
why: 离 + place + 有 + distance states how far apart two points are. 从 describes where a movement starts and would need a verb such as 走.
zh: 地铁站离这儿有两百米。

src_py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù gōng sī
task: Say you go by bike instead.
zh: 我骑自行车去公司。
py: wǒ qí zì xíng chē qù gōng sī
en: I go to the office by bike.
why: Bikes take 骑, not 坐, and the vehicle phrase still stands before 去.

q: 我家___公园很近。
py: wǒ jiā lí gōng yuán hěn jìn
en: My home is close to the park.
why: The gap between two fixed points, followed by 很近, is 离. 从 needs a starting point of movement or time and cannot be followed by 很近.
zh: 我家离公园很近。

src_py: jiào liàn gěi wǒ men dǎ diàn huà le
zh: 教练没给我们打电话。
py: jiào liàn méi gěi wǒ men dǎ diàn huà
en: The coach didn't call us.
why: 没 stands before the coverb 给我们, and 了 is dropped because 没 already says it did not happen.

zh: 我也想跟你们去踢球。
py: wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ men qù tī qiú
en: I want to go and play football with you too.
why: 也 and the modal 想 come before the coverb phrase 跟你们, and the verb phrase comes last.

zh: 我们不坐出租车去体育馆。
py: wǒ men bù zuò chū zū chē qù tǐ yù guǎn
en: We're not going to the gym by taxi.
why: 不 goes before the coverb phrase 坐出租车, which stays before the verb. 坐出租车不去 would say something quite different.

q: 我们平时___在体育馆打乒乓球，都在公园打。
py: wǒ men píng shí bù zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ pīng pāng qiú dōu zài gōng yuán dǎ
en: We usually don't play table tennis at the gym; we always play in the park.
why: 平时 describes a habit, so the negative is 不, placed before the coverb 在. 没 negates completed events and 别 is a command.
zh: 我们平时不在体育馆打乒乓球，都在公园打。
他对足球一点儿也不感兴趣。
py: tā duì zú qiú yī diǎn r yě bù gǎn xìng qù
en: He is not the least bit interested in football.
why: A fronted topic is fine, but 一点儿也不 stays right before 感兴趣, after the 对 phrase. The 对 phrase cannot follow the predicate.

s: 我送他在机场了。
s_py: wǒ sòng tā zài jī chǎng le
zh: 我送他到机场了。
py: wǒ sòng tā dào jī chǎng le
en: I took him to the airport.
why: A destination someone is taken to attaches to 送 as 到. 在 marks a static location, so 送他在机场 does not say where he was taken.

zh: 我弟弟用左手打乒乓球。
py: wǒ dì di yòng zuǒ shǒu dǎ pīng pāng qiú
en: My younger brother plays table tennis with his left hand.
why: The tool phrase 用左手 comes before the verb 打, not after the object as English 'with his left hand' would suggest.

q: 请___我们介绍一下这个公园的历史。
py: qǐng gěi wǒ men jiè shào yī xià zhè ge gōng yuán de lì shǐ
en: Please tell us a little about the history of this park.
why: The audience for an introduction is marked by 给 before 介绍. 从 and 往 mark a starting point and a direction, and 离 a distance, none of which is a listener.
zh: 请给我们介绍一下这个公园的历史。
我们想跟朋友一起去爬山。
py: wǒ men xiǎng gēn péng you yī qǐ qù pá shān
en: We want to go hiking with our friends.
why: The modal 想 comes first, then the partner phrase 跟朋友, then 一起 and the verb. The partner cannot follow 去爬山.

zh: 我每天坐地铁去公司。
py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě qù gōng sī
en: I go to the office by subway every day.
why: The vehicle phrase 坐地铁 comes before 去 and the destination. Putting 坐地铁 after 去公司 is English order and is wrong.

s: 他一直住在体育馆旁边。
s_py: tā yī zhí zhù zài tǐ yù guǎn páng biān
zh: 他一直住在体育馆旁边。
py: tā yī zhí zhù zài tǐ yù guǎn páng biān
en: He has always lived next to the gym.
why: 住 is one of the few verbs where 在 follows the verb, so 住在 is correct. Do not 'fix' it by moving the place before the verb.

q: 我把他送___机场了。
py: wǒ bǎ tā sòng dào jī chǎng le
en: I took him to the airport.
why: 送 plus a destination takes 到 right after the verb: 送到机场. 送给 would mean giving something to the airport, and 在 marks a static position.
zh: 我把他送到机场了。

s: 离我家到学校走路要十分钟。
s_py: lí wǒ jiā dào xué xiào zǒu lù yào shí fēn zhōng
zh: 从我家到学校走路要十分钟。
py: cóng wǒ jiā dào xué xiào zǒu lù yào shí fēn zhōng
en: It takes ten minutes on foot from my home to school.
why: A start-to-end route is 从…到. 离 measures a gap and cannot pair with 到.

q: 我明天有事，你能___我去参加比赛吗？
py: wǒ míng tiān yǒu shì nǐ néng tì wǒ qù cān jiā bǐ sài ma
en: I'm busy tomorrow; can you go and take part in the match in my place?
why: Acting in someone's place is 替. 跟 would mean going together with me, which contradicts the cue that I cannot go. 往 and 离 are direction and distance.
zh: 我明天有事，你能替我去参加比赛吗？

q: 到了红绿灯，请___右拐。
py: dào le hóng lǜ dēng qǐng wǎng yòu guǎi
en: At the traffic lights, please turn right.
why: A direction plus a movement verb (拐) takes 往. 对 and 给 mark a person, and 离 measures distance.
zh: 到了红绿灯，请往右拐。

s: 我跟游泳很感兴趣。
s_py: wǒ gēn yóu yǒng hěn gǎn xìng qù
zh: 我对游泳很感兴趣。
py: wǒ duì yóu yǒng hěn gǎn xìng qù
en: I'm very interested in swimming.
why: 感兴趣 takes its object with 对. 跟 marks a partner in a mutual act, and swimming cannot be a partner.

q: 周末我们打算___自行车去郊区玩。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men dǎ suàn qí zì xíng chē qù jiāo qū wán
en: We plan to cycle out to the suburbs at the weekend.
why: Bicycles are ridden, so the verb is 骑. 坐 is for being carried in a vehicle, 开 is for driving one, and 用 names a tool.
zh: 周末我们打算骑自行车去郊区玩。
我家离公园很近。
py: wǒ jiā lí gōng yuán hěn jìn
en: My home is close to the park.
why: 离 sits between the two places and the description 很近 follows. 从 could not be used because nothing moves.

s: 你放心去比赛吧，我替你照顾孩子。
s_py: nǐ fàng xīn qù bǐ sài ba wǒ tì nǐ zhào gù hái zi
zh: 你放心去比赛吧，我替你照顾孩子。
py: nǐ fàng xīn qù bǐ sài ba wǒ tì nǐ zhào gù hái zi
en: Go and play in the match without worry; I'll look after the child for you.
why: 替 means taking over a task in your place, so I look after the child instead of you. The sentence is correct.

task: Add 一直 to say keep going straight.
zh: 你一直往前走。
py: nǐ yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu
en: Just keep going straight ahead.
why: 一直 goes before the whole 往 phrase and the verb.

q: 他刚___篮球场回来，满头大汗。
py: tā gāng cóng lán qiú chǎng huí lai mǎn tóu dà hàn
en: He has just come back from the basketball court, drenched in sweat.
why: The place a movement starts from is 从, here with 回来. 往 would mean towards the court, and 离 and 在 do not mark a point of departure.
zh: 他刚从篮球场回来，满头大汗。

q: 他做错了，应该___老师道歉。
py: tā zuò cuò le yīng gāi xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn
en: He was wrong and should apologise to the teacher.
why: 道歉 is an abstract act aimed at a person, which is 向's job. 往 needs a place or direction and real movement; 在 and 离 do not mark a person.
zh: 他做错了，应该向老师道歉。

q: 我爸爸最近___一个老朋友商量开一家自行车店的事。
py: wǒ bà ba zuì jìn gēn yī gè lǎo péng you shāng liang kāi yī jiā zì xíng chē diàn de shì
en: My father has recently been discussing opening a bicycle shop with an old friend.
why: 商量 is mutual and takes 跟 or 和 for the partner. 对 and 给 cannot introduce a discussion partner, and 向 goes with abstract verbs like 学习 and 道歉, not 商量.
zh: 我爸爸最近跟一个老朋友商量开一家自行车店的事。

q: 雨太大了，我们别___自行车去了，___出租车吧。
py: yǔ tài dà le wǒ men bié qí zì xíng chē qù le zuò chū zū chē ba
en: The rain is too heavy; let's not cycle there but take a taxi.
why: Bikes are ridden (骑) and taxis are sat in (坐). Swapping them gives 坐自行车 and 骑出租车, and 用 or 开 do not fit either.
zh: 雨太大了，我们别骑自行车去了，坐出租车吧。

q: 他每个周末都___社区的篮球场___朋友打球。
py: tā měi gè zhōu mò dōu zài shè qū de lán qiú chǎng gēn péng you dǎ qiú
en: Every weekend he plays ball with his friends at the neighbourhood basketball court.
why: The place of the activity takes 在 and the playing partners take 跟, both before the verb. Reversing them, or using 给 or 对 for the friends, breaks the meaning.
zh: 他每个周末都在社区的篮球场跟朋友打球。

q: 去体育馆太远了，我们___公共汽车去吧。
py: qù tǐ yù guǎn tài yuǎn le wǒ men zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù ba
en: The gym is too far; let's take the bus.
why: A bus you ride in as a passenger takes 坐. 骑 is for bikes, 开 means driving it as the driver, and 用 names a tool.
zh: 去体育馆太远了，我们坐公共汽车去吧。

q: 出了地铁站，请___东走五分钟，就能看到那家书店。
py: chū le dì tiě zhàn qǐng wǎng dōng zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng jiù néng kàn dào nà jiā shū diàn
en: After leaving the subway station, walk east for five minutes and you'll see the bookshop.
why: 往 + direction + movement verb gives the way to go. 在东走 would put the walking at a place, and 对 and 给 mark people.
zh: 出了地铁站，请往东走五分钟，就能看到那家书店。

q: 老师把作业还___我们了。
py: lǎo shī bǎ zuò yè huán gěi wǒ men le
en: The teacher gave our homework back to us.
why: 还 plus a recipient needs 给 directly after the verb: 还给. 向 and 在 cannot follow 还 here, and 到 requires a place, not a person.
zh: 老师把作业还给我们了。

q: 我们周末___公园打篮球。
py: wǒ men zhōu mò zài gōng yuán dǎ lán qiú
en: We play basketball in the park at weekends.
why: The place where an activity happens is 在 plus the place, before the verb. 跟 needs a person and 往 needs a movement verb, so neither can introduce 公园 here.
zh: 我们周末在公园打篮球。

s: 我对足球不太感兴趣，对篮球也不感兴趣。
s_py: wǒ duì zú qiú bù tài gǎn xìng qù duì lán qiú yě bù gǎn xìng qù
zh: 我对足球不太感兴趣，对篮球也不感兴趣。
py: wǒ duì zú qiú bù tài gǎn xìng qù duì lán qiú yě bù gǎn xìng qù
en: I'm not very interested in football, and I'm not interested in basketball either.
why: With the state predicate 感兴趣, 不 and 也 sit between the 对 phrase and the predicate. That is the correct slot.

q: 明天有比赛，请你把参赛表交___张老师，再把我的球衣搬___体育馆。
py: míng tiān yǒu bǐ sài qǐng nǐ bǎ cān sài biǎo jiāo gěi zhāng lǎo shī zài bǎ wǒ de qiú yī bān dào tǐ yù guǎn
en: Tomorrow is the match; please hand the entry form to Teacher Zhang and carry my jersey over to the gym.
why: A person who receives is 交给; a place something is moved to is 搬到. Swapping them gives 交到张老师 and 搬给体育馆, which do not work.
zh: 明天有比赛，请你把参赛表交给张老师，再把我的球衣搬到体育馆。

s: 教练给我们没发通知。
s_py: jiào liàn gěi wǒ men méi fā tōng zhī
zh: 教练没给我们发通知。
py: jiào liàn méi gěi wǒ men fā tōng zhī
en: The coach didn't send us a notice.
why: 没 goes before the coverb 给我们, not after it, when the main verb is an action.

zh: 小王明天在体育馆打乒乓球。
py: xiǎo wáng míng tiān zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ pīng pāng qiú
en: Xiao Wang is playing table tennis at the gym tomorrow.
why: Time, then place, then the action: 在体育馆 sits before 打乒乓球. English puts the place last, but in Chinese the phrase cannot follow the verb.

q: 教练把比赛的时间写___黑板上了。
py: jiào liàn bǎ bǐ sài de shí jiān xiě zài hēi bǎn shàng le
en: The coach wrote the match time on the blackboard.
why: The blackboard is where the writing ends up, so 在 attaches to 写. 给 would make it a recipient, and 从 and 对 cannot follow 写.
zh: 教练把比赛的时间写在黑板上了。

q: 他是___北京来的。
py: tā shì cóng běi jīng lái de
en: He is from Beijing.
why: The place someone comes from is the starting point of movement, so 从. 离 only measures distance and cannot go with 来.
zh: 他是从北京来的。

q: 我把照片发___你了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhào piàn fā gěi nǐ le
en: I've sent you the photos.
why: A thing passed to a person is 发给 + person right after the verb. 到 needs a place, so 发到你 is incomplete, and 对 cannot follow a verb.
zh: 我把照片发给你了。

s: 她把自行车放在门口。
s_py: tā bǎ zì xíng chē fàng zài mén kǒu
zh: 她把自行车放在门口。
py: tā bǎ zì xíng chē fàng zài mén kǒu
en: She left her bicycle by the door.
why: The door is where the bike ends up, so 在 follows 放 directly, with 把 in front. The sentence is correct.

q: 请把书放___桌子上。
py: qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: Please put the book on the table.
why: 放 plus where the thing ends up takes 在 right after the verb. 给 would make the table a recipient, and 从 and 对 cannot follow 放.
zh: 请把书放在桌子上。

s: 他们打篮球在公园。
s_py: tā men dǎ lán qiú zài gōng yuán
zh: 他们在公园打篮球。
py: tā men zài gōng yuán dǎ lán qiú
en: They play basketball in the park.
why: The place of an activity must come before the verb. 打篮球在公园 copies English word order, and no native speaker says it.

q: 我弟弟从小就___游泳很感兴趣，现在天天去游泳馆。
py: wǒ dì di cóng xiǎo jiù duì yóu yǒng hěn gǎn xìng qù xiàn zài tiān tiān qù yóu yǒng guǎn
en: My younger brother has been interested in swimming since he was little and goes to the pool every day now.
why: 感兴趣 needs 对 for its object. 跟 and 给 mark a partner and a recipient, and 为 gives a beneficiary rather than a topic of interest.
zh: 我弟弟从小就对游泳很感兴趣，现在天天去游泳馆。
我家离地铁站不远。
py: wǒ jiā lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
en: My home is not far from the subway station.
why: With an adjective predicate, 不 goes directly before 远, after the 离 phrase. 我家不离地铁站远 is not Chinese.

q: 妈妈把我的球鞋放___门口了。
py: mā ma bǎ wǒ de qiú xié fàng zài mén kǒu le
en: Mum put my sports shoes by the door.
why: The door is where the shoes end up, so 在 attaches to 放: 放在门口. 给 would make the door a recipient, and 对 cannot follow a verb.
zh: 妈妈把我的球鞋放在门口了。

q: 小李今天生病了，教练让我___他参加接力赛。
py: xiǎo lǐ jīn tiān shēng bìng le jiào liàn ràng wǒ tì tā cān jiā jiē lì sài
en: Xiao Li is ill today, so the coach asked me to run the relay in his place.
why: Taking someone's place is 替. 跟 would put us in the race together, which contradicts the fact that he is ill. 往 and 离 fit neither.
zh: 小李今天生病了，教练让我替他参加接力赛。

s: 他经常给我们介绍新的运动。
s_py: tā jīng cháng gěi wǒ men jiè shào xīn de yùn dòng
zh: 他经常给我们介绍新的运动。
py: tā jīng cháng gěi wǒ men jiè shào xīn de yùn dòng
en: He often introduces new sports to us.
why: 给 marks the people who receive the introduction and stands before 介绍. The sentence is correct.

q: 他右手受伤了，只好___左手写字。
py: tā yòu shǒu shòu shāng le zhǐ hǎo yòng zuǒ shǒu xiě zì
en: His right hand is hurt, so he has to write with his left.
why: The instrument used for an action is 用 + tool before the verb. 对, 给 and 往 mark a target, a recipient and a direction, none of which is a hand used as a tool.
zh: 他右手受伤了，只好用左手写字。

s: 你赢了，我真对你高兴。
s_py: nǐ yíng le wǒ zhēn duì nǐ gāo xìng
zh: 你赢了，我真为你高兴。
py: nǐ yíng le wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
en: You won; I'm really happy for you.
why: Being glad on someone's account is 为. 对 aims an attitude at a person and cannot go with 高兴.

q: 那个孩子一边哭一边___妈妈跑过去。
py: nà ge hái zi yī biān kū yī biān cháo mā ma pǎo guò qu
en: The child ran towards his mother, crying as he went.
why: Running while facing a person takes 朝 (or 向). 离 measures distance, 在 would place the running at the mother's side, and 给 marks a recipient.
zh: 那个孩子一边哭一边朝妈妈跑过去。

q: 我家离体育馆___远，走路只要五分钟。
py: wǒ jiā lí tǐ yù guǎn bù yuǎn zǒu lù zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng
en: My home is not far from the gym; it only takes five minutes on foot.
why: With 离 the negative 不 sits on the predicate 远, after the coverb phrase. 很远 would contradict 'only five minutes on foot', 没 negates 有 or past events, and 别 is a command.
zh: 我家离体育馆不远，走路只要五分钟。

q: ___图书馆到火车站坐地铁要二十分钟。
py: cóng tú shū guǎn dào huǒ chē zhàn zuò dì tiě yào èr shí fēn zhōng
en: It takes twenty minutes by subway from the library to the railway station.
why: A route with 到 for its end needs 从 for its start. 离 does not pair with 到, and 在 and 对 cannot open a start-to-end pair.
zh: 从图书馆到火车站坐地铁要二十分钟。

q: 他昨天___我发了一条短信，问我周末去不去爬山。
py: tā zuó tiān gěi wǒ fā le yī tiáo duǎn xìn wèn wǒ zhōu mò qù bu qù pá shān
en: Yesterday he sent me a text asking whether I'd go hiking at the weekend.
why: The recipient of a message is marked by 给 before 发. 对 aims an attitude, 跟 marks a partner, and 往 needs a place.
zh: 他昨天给我发了一条短信，问我周末去不去爬山。

src_py: wǒ tì nǐ qù kāi huì
task: Ask a friend to do it for you: 你能…吗？
zh: 你能替我去开会吗？
py: nǐ néng tì wǒ qù kāi huì ma
en: Can you go to the meeting in my place?
why: The modal 能 comes before the 替 phrase, which stays before 去开会, and 吗 closes the question.

q: 他喜欢___筷子吃面条。
py: tā xǐ huan yòng kuài zi chī miàn tiáo
en: He likes to eat noodles with chopsticks.
why: A tool used to do the action takes 用 before the verb. 坐 is for vehicles, 在 for places and 给 for a recipient; chopsticks are none of these.
zh: 他喜欢用筷子吃面条。

q: 经常运动___身体很好。
py: jīng cháng yùn dòng duì shēn tǐ hěn hǎo
en: Exercising often is very good for your health.
why: 对…好 marks what something is good for. 跟身体好 and 给身体好 do not exist, and 向 only goes with people and abstract verbs.
zh: 经常运动对身体很好。

q: 医生说，每天散步半小时___身体有很大的帮助。
py: yī shēng shuō měi tiān sàn bù bàn xiǎo shí duì shēn tǐ yǒu hěn dà de bāng zhù
en: The doctor says that walking for half an hour a day is a great help to your body.
why: 对…有帮助 marks what is affected. 给身体有帮助 is not the pattern, and 跟 and 往 do not fit a benefit to the body.
zh: 医生说，每天散步半小时对身体有很大的帮助。

s: 比赛输了以后，她向大家道了歉。
s_py: bǐ sài shū le yǐ hòu tā xiàng dà jiā dào le qiàn
zh: 比赛输了以后，她向大家道了歉。
py: bǐ sài shū le yǐ hòu tā xiàng dà jiā dào le qiàn
en: After losing the match she apologised to everyone.
why: 道歉 is an abstract act aimed at people, which 向 marks, and 了 goes right after the verb 道. Nothing is wrong here.

q: 现在___比赛开始还有两个小时。
py: xiàn zài lí bǐ sài kāi shǐ hái yǒu liǎng gè xiǎo shí
en: There are still two hours until the match starts.
why: 离 plus 还有 plus a time gives the time gap until an event. 往 and 对 do not measure gaps, and 给 marks a recipient.
zh: 现在离比赛开始还有两个小时。

q: 你一直___前走，过了桥就是银行。
py: nǐ yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu guò le qiáo jiù shì yín háng
en: Keep going straight ahead, and the bank is right after the bridge.
why: A direction (前) with a movement verb (走) takes 往. 对 and 给 mark people, and 离 is distance.
zh: 你一直往前走，过了桥就是银行。

q: 请___手机扫一下这个二维码。
py: qǐng yòng shǒu jī sǎo yī xià zhè ge èr wéi mǎ
en: Please scan this QR code with your phone.
why: The tool that does the scanning takes 用 before the verb. 坐 is for vehicles, 给 for a recipient and 往 for a direction.
zh: 请用手机扫一下这个二维码。
我把球鞋放在门口了。
py: wǒ bǎ qiú xié fàng zài mén kǒu le
en: I put my sports shoes by the door.
why: The object moves forward with 把, 在 stays glued to 放, and 了 closes the whole unit. Nothing can come between 放 and 在.

zh: 教练对我们很好。
py: jiào liàn duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
en: The coach is good to us.
why: The 对 phrase goes before the adjective, and 很 sits directly on 好. The target of the attitude cannot come after 好.

q: 他想___你商量一下比赛的事。
py: tā xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liang yī xià bǐ sài de shì
en: He wants to discuss the match with you.
why: 商量 is mutual, so the partner takes 跟 or 和. 给 would make you a recipient and 对 an attitude target, neither of which suits 商量.
zh: 他想跟你商量一下比赛的事。

q: 我哥哥___篮球很感兴趣。
py: wǒ gē ge duì lán qiú hěn gǎn xìng qù
en: My older brother is very interested in basketball.
why: The object of interest is marked by 对: 对…感兴趣. 跟 would mean doing something together with basketball, which makes no sense.
zh: 我哥哥对篮球很感兴趣。

q: 我们应该___这位老运动员学习。
py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng zhè wèi lǎo yùn dòng yuán xué xí
en: We should learn from this veteran athlete.
why: Learning from a person is 向…学习. 往 needs a place or direction and real movement, and 离 and 在 do not mark the source of learning.
zh: 我们应该向这位老运动员学习。

src_py: mèi mei gěi wǒ fā duǎn xìn
zh: 妹妹不给我发短信。
py: mèi mei bù gěi wǒ fā duǎn xìn
en: My younger sister doesn't text me.
why: 不 goes before the coverb phrase 给我, not between 给我 and 发短信.

q: 昨天我把朋友送___地铁站，然后自己回家了。
py: zuó tiān wǒ bǎ péng you sòng dào dì tiě zhàn rán hòu zì jǐ huí jiā le
en: Yesterday I saw my friend to the subway station and then went home alone.
why: 送 plus a destination takes 到 right after the verb. 送给 would mean giving the friend away to the station, and 在 does not mark arrival.
zh: 昨天我把朋友送到地铁站，然后自己回家了。

q: 我每天___地铁去上班。
py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě qù shàng bān
en: I go to work by subway every day.
why: A vehicle you ride in as a passenger takes 坐. 骑 is for bikes and horses, 开 means driving it yourself, and 用 names a tool, not transport.
zh: 我每天坐地铁去上班。

q: 我今晚想___你打电话。
py: wǒ jīn wǎn xiǎng gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
en: I want to call you tonight.
why: The person who receives a call is marked by 给 before 打电话. 对 would aim an attitude at you, and 往 and 从 need places.
zh: 我今晚想给你打电话。

q: 他笑着___我挥了挥手。
py: tā xiào zhe xiàng wǒ huī le huī shǒu
en: He smiled and waved at me.
why: Facing a person to do something to them takes 向 (or 朝). 往 needs a direction or place, and 从 and 离 are a starting point and a distance.
zh: 他笑着向我挥了挥手。

q: 你坐___这儿吧，这儿有空位。
py: nǐ zuò zài zhè r ba zhè r yǒu kòng wèi
en: Sit here; there is a free seat here.
why: 坐 plus the seat where one ends up takes 在 right after the verb. 给 would make 这儿 a recipient, and 对 and 从 cannot follow 坐.
zh: 你坐在这儿吧，这儿有空位。
教练昨天没给我们打电话。
py: jiào liàn zuó tiān méi gěi wǒ men dǎ diàn huà
en: The coach didn't call us yesterday.
why: With an action verb, 没 goes before the coverb phrase 给我们, not between 给我们 and 打电话.

q: 请你把这张票交___他。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè zhāng piào jiāo gěi tā
en: Please hand this ticket over to him.
why: 交 plus a recipient takes 给 right after the verb: 交给他. 在 and 到 need a place, and 对 cannot follow a verb.
zh: 请你把这张票交给他。

s: 他对我也很好。
s_py: tā duì wǒ yě hěn hǎo
zh: 他对我也很好。
py: tā duì wǒ yě hěn hǎo
en: He is nice to me too.
why: 也 can sit between the 对 phrase and the adjective 好, saying he is nice to me as well. The sentence is correct.

q: 听说你拿了冠军，我真___你高兴。
py: tīng shuō nǐ ná le guàn jūn wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
en: I hear you won the championship; I'm really happy for you.
why: Being glad on someone's account takes 为. 对 would aim the feeling at the person, which 高兴 does not allow, and 跟 is for partners.
zh: 听说你拿了冠军，我真为你高兴。

q: 比赛结束后，球员们___观众鞠躬，然后慢慢走出了球场。
py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu qiú yuán men cháo guān zhòng jū gōng rán hòu màn màn zǒu chū le qiú chǎng
en: After the match the players bowed to the crowd and then slowly walked off the pitch.
why: Bowing while facing people takes 朝 (or 向). 往 needs a direction word or place, 从 gives a starting point, and 跟 would mean bowing together with them.
zh: 比赛结束后，球员们朝观众鞠躬，然后慢慢走出了球场。

q: 教练___我们要求很严格。
py: jiào liàn duì wǒ men yāo qiú hěn yán gé
en: The coach is very strict with us.
why: 对…要求严格 uses 对 for the target of an attitude. 给 and 跟 mark a recipient and a partner, and the coach is not giving us the demands.
zh: 教练对我们要求很严格。
